principle: A mechanical synthetic certification or frozen replay remains valid within its stated scope, but it is not promoted to an empirical configurable capability.

blocked_modes.mode: Empirical factor allocation and FACTORS end-to-end pipeline
blocked_modes.human_explanation: The repository has a certified factor implementation engine, but no complete dated stream of economic factor targets, tradable FACTORS_BY_ASSETS loadings, factor covariance, specific risk and tracking metric available at each historical decision.
blocked_modes.what_remains_valid: AL-04 synthetic optimization, validation, PIT selector mechanics, sensitivities and independent numerical certification.
blocked_modes.what_cannot_be_concluded: No empirical factor backtest, factor allocation history, factor alpha, historical gate outcome or end-to-end factor portfolio result can be claimed.
blocked_modes.minimum_remediation: Commit a versioned, hashed, complete PIT factor-artifact history with units, axes, provenance and availability timestamps, then execute the existing allocator and validation orchestration without substituting feature definitions for economic factor portfolios.

blocked_modes.human_explanation: The strategy allocator requires canonical strategy-instance histories and dated position maps. The available legacy response is one short current snapshot and two preparation bundles are Git LFS pointers, not usable committed payloads.
blocked_modes.what_remains_valid: AL-05 strategy identity, allocation, mapping, residual-capital, constraints, risk diagnostics and temporal-selection mechanics on synthetic fixtures.
blocked_modes.what_cannot_be_concluded: No historical strategy allocation, costs, mapped book, performance, alpha or strategy ranking can be claimed.
blocked_modes.minimum_remediation: Materialize and commit or otherwise identify immutable canonical payloads for the missing histories/maps, with version and publication time, and add a committed empirical loader for the existing AL-05 Input contract.

blocked_modes.human_explanation: BANK-01 has no committed empirical loader or complete NET PIT return and mapping history from which to calculate historical correlations, clusters and active membership.
blocked_modes.what_remains_valid: Deterministic synthetic BANK-01 eligibility, correlation, clustering, redundancy, temporal visibility, immutable IDs and resume behavior.
blocked_modes.what_cannot_be_concluded: No real strategy was historically active, redundant, diversified or eligible; no empirical bank history exists.
blocked_modes.minimum_remediation: Supply a canonical committed historical strategy dataset and a loader that maps it into the existing BANK-01 Input contract at explicit decision dates and cutoffs.

blocked_modes.mode: Historical promotion, activation and Dynamic Active Set
blocked_modes.human_explanation: PIPE-02 contains no real ex-ante promotion history for the empirical 2020-2021 period; QA approvals cannot be backdated into historical governance. PIPE-03 therefore has only synthetic bank states.
missing_data_artifact_contract: historical promotion evidence as available then
blocked_modes.what_remains_valid: PIPE-02 exact archival target byte comparison and synthetic lifecycle/routing logic; PIPE-03 synthetic projection and integration mechanics. PROMOTED, ACTIVE and ALLOCATED remain separate states.
blocked_modes.what_cannot_be_concluded: No target or strategy can be described as historically promoted/active, and no empirical dynamic active-set or governed end-to-end result can be claimed.
blocked_modes.minimum_remediation: Commit immutable contemporaneous governance events, evidence, policies, authority and activation histories with effective/available timestamps, then replay them under the existing temporal registry contract.

blocked_modes.mode: Empirical MEAN_VARIANCE and MAX_SHARPE asset allocation
blocked_modes.human_explanation: These objectives consume expected returns, and the committed empirical allocation snapshot does not contain a canonical dated expected-return stream. The engine intentionally refuses to infer one or default it to zero.
blocked_modes.what_remains_valid: Synthetic MEAN_VARIANCE/MAX_SHARPE mechanics and empirical EQUAL_WEIGHT, MIN_VARIANCE and ERC paths.
blocked_modes.what_cannot_be_concluded: No empirical mean-variance or maximum-Sharpe weights, selection result or performance can be reported.
blocked_modes.minimum_remediation: Commit an ex-ante PIT expected-return producer/output contract and its dated artifacts, then expose them through the existing AL-03/AL-07 source adapter.

blocked_modes.human_explanation: The repository lacks the original Node-3 signal-gate source and its historical ranking/feature publication stream. The new canonical gate is mechanically certified but cannot establish legacy equivalence or historical outcomes.
blocked_modes.what_remains_valid: The isolated canonical AL-06 signal gate, synthetic PCA/coverage/dispersion/rank-stability tests and cutoff enforcement.
blocked_modes.what_cannot_be_concluded: No historical signal-quality PASS/FAIL, legacy-equivalence claim or empirical signal eligibility conclusion is available.
blocked_modes.minimum_remediation: Recover and commit the original implementation and historical inputs, or explicitly approve a new methodology and generate genuinely dated PIT inputs prospectively; do not relabel the synthetic canonical gate as legacy replay.

blocked_modes.mode: Signed, leveraged or non-net-one strategy implementation
blocked_modes.human_explanation: The certified ExposureController and execution paths cover the declared long-only/net-one scope. A signed strategy exposure cannot be converted into implementation cash as 1 minus net exposure without a financing contract.
blocked_modes.what_remains_valid: Long-only ASSETS allocation, supported pure long-only mapped strategy fixtures and the separation of internal residual from implementation cash.
blocked_modes.what_cannot_be_concluded: No leveraged, short, market-neutral or signed mapped portfolio can be treated as executable under the current controller.
blocked_modes.minimum_remediation: Define and certify a distinct signed financing/controller/execution contract with explicit gross, net, cash, collateral, borrow and fee accounting.

blocked_modes.human_explanation: The research engines expose PSR diagnostics but do not implement DSR or a multiple-testing correction. They explicitly avoid turning the selected Sharpe into a significance claim.
blocked_modes.what_remains_valid: Observed metrics, per-fold distributions, PSR under its declared assumptions and mechanical selection behavior.
blocked_modes.what_cannot_be_concluded: No statistical significance, robust profitability or alpha claim follows from candidate selection.
blocked_modes.minimum_remediation: Specify, independently validate and predeclare an inference contract before using DSR; retain all candidate trials and dependence assumptions.

blocked_modes.human_explanation: runBacktestEngine is callable and fully used downstream, but CL-01 by itself has no committed configuration normalization, dataset identity, output-root, provenance and run-identity contract.
blocked_modes.what_remains_valid: Backtest accounting, execution timing, cost fields and downstream empirical uses.
blocked_modes.what_cannot_be_concluded: An arbitrary direct library call is not by itself an auditable ResearchRun.
blocked_modes.minimum_remediation: Use the Phase-A ResearchRun contract through a thin adapter around the unchanged engine, or continue to invoke it through an existing certified orchestration path.

blocked_modes.human_explanation: PIPE-01 recalculates financial stages and books, but its empirical loader accepts only fixed AL-07 selected jobs; its CLI exposes no dates, universe, objective, mandate or cost input and does not rerun candidate selection.
missing_data_artifact_contract: user run request mapped to pipeline context/bundles
blocked_modes.what_remains_valid: Exact frozen empirical ASSETS replay, PIT checks, accounting, gates, controller and 0/5-bps reconciliation.
blocked_modes.what_cannot_be_concluded: PIPE-01 cannot currently support configure-change-rerun as a standalone product backend.
blocked_modes.minimum_remediation: Add a thin, non-financial adapter that consumes a normalized ResearchRunSpec and invokes an already executable upstream research path; do not modify certified financial stages.
